name: Slider
description:
A value (or a range) picked along a track. The number of thumbs follows the value: a number renders one, an array one per entry.

  Slider(default_value: 50, thumb_aria_label: "Volume")
  Slider(default_value: [ 25, 75 ], thumb_aria_label: [ "Minimum", "Maximum" ], name: "price")
  Slider(default_value: 40, step: 10, tooltip: :always, format: { style: "percent" }, max: 1)

Each thumb holds a visually hidden native <input type="range"> - it carries the name, the value, aria-valuenow and the focus, so the slider submits with forms. The `ui--slider` controller adds dragging anywhere on the track, the keyboard (arrows by `step`, Shift / Page Up·Down by `large_step`, Home / End) and keeps the fill, thumbs and tooltips in sync. It emits `ui--slider:change` while moving and `ui--slider:commit` on release, both with { value }.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes UI (e.g. `Slider(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

examples.name: Usage
examples.code:
phlex do
  Slider(tooltip:, disabled:, min:, max:, large_step:, min_steps_between_values:, orientation:, **given(name:), default_value: value.to_f, step: step.to_f, thumb_aria_label:, class: "max-w-70")
end

examples.name: Range
examples.notes: An array value renders a thumb per entry; name each end with `thumb_aria_label:`.
examples.code: phlex { Slider(default_value: [ 25, 75 ], thumb_aria_label: %w[ Minimum Maximum ], class: "max-w-70") }

examples.name: Steps
examples.notes: `step:` sets the granularity; Shift / Page Up·Down move by `large_step:`.
examples.code: phlex { Slider(default_value: 40, step: 10, tooltip: :always, thumb_aria_label: "Amount", class: "max-w-70 mt-6") }

examples.name: Tooltip visibility
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex w-full max-w-70 flex-col gap-8 pt-6") do
    Slider(default_value: 30, tooltip: :auto, thumb_aria_label: "Auto")
    Slider(default_value: 50, tooltip: :always, thumb_aria_label: "Always")
    Slider(default_value: 70, tooltip: :never, thumb_aria_label: "Never")
  end
end

examples.name: Formatted
examples.notes: `format:` takes Intl.NumberFormat options for the tooltip and aria-valuetext.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex w-full max-w-70 flex-col gap-10 pt-6") do
    Slider(default_value: 0.4, max: 1, step: 0.05, format: { style: "percent" }, tooltip: :always, thumb_aria_label: "Opacity")
    Slider(default_value: [ 120, 480 ], min: 0, max: 1000, step: 10, format: { style: "currency", currency: "USD", maximum_fraction_digits: 0 }, tooltip: :always, thumb_aria_label: %w[ From To ])
  end
end

examples.name: Vertical
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex h-48 items-center gap-10") do
    Slider(orientation: :vertical, default_value: 60, thumb_aria_label: "Volume")
    Slider(orientation: :vertical, default_value: [ 20, 80 ], thumb_aria_label: %w[ Min Max ])
  end
end

examples.name: Reacting to changes
examples.notes: `ui--slider:change` fires while moving - three sliders drive an RGB swatch.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex w-full max-w-90 items-center gap-6", data: { demo: "rgb" }) do
    div(class: "flex w-full max-w-64 flex-col gap-4") do
      { r: 99, g: 102, b: 241 }.each do |channel, value|
        div(class: "flex items-center gap-3") do
          span(class: "text-foreground-muted w-3 text-sm font-medium") { channel.to_s.upcase }
          Slider(default_value: value, max: 255, tooltip: :never, thumb_aria_label: "#{channel.upcase} channel", class: "flex-1", data: { channel: })
          span(class: "text-foreground-muted w-8 text-end text-sm tabular-nums", data: { output: channel }) { value.to_s }
        end
      end
    end
    div(class: "flex shrink-0 flex-col items-center gap-2") do
      div(class: "border-border-muted size-20 rounded-lg border", style: "background-color: #6366f1", data: { demo: "swatch" })
      span(class: "text-foreground-muted font-mono text-xs uppercase", data: { demo: "hex" }) { "#6366f1" }
    end
  end
  script(type: "module") do
    raw safe(<<~JS)
      const demo = document.querySelector("[data-demo=rgb]")
      const rgb = { r: 99, g: 102, b: 241 }
      demo.addEventListener("ui--slider:change", ({ target, detail: { value } }) => {
        const channel = target.dataset.channel
        rgb[channel] = value
        demo.querySelector(`[data-output=${channel}]`).textContent = value
        const hex = "#" + [ rgb.r, rgb.g, rgb.b ].map(c => c.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("")
        demo.querySelector("[data-demo=swatch]").style.backgroundColor = hex
        demo.querySelector("[data-demo=hex]").textContent = hex
      })
    JS
  end
end

examples.name: Disabled
examples.code: phlex { Slider(default_value: 50, disabled: true, thumb_aria_label: "Disabled", class: "max-w-70") }

examples.name: RTL
examples.notes: The fill grows from the right and ←/→ follow the reading direction.
examples.code: phlex { div(dir: "rtl", class: "w-full max-w-70") { Slider(default_value: [ 20, 60 ], thumb_aria_label: %w[ الأدنى الأعلى ]) } }
